text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Good work.
Right now, I am offering detailed explanations
of the "Grand Masters" to anyone interested—

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
<username>,
do you need an explanation?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Now then, what would you like me to explain?
Speaking of things to ask about training for the Grand Masters—
choice_data_list: About Training Goals and Special Races

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Regarding "Training Goals and Special Races," right?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: "The VR software 'Mega Dream Supporter'—the Three Goddesses residing within provide generous support for a trainee Umamusume's training!♪"

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Over the course of three years, please utilize the support of the Three Goddesses to challenge the Twinkle Series and guide your trainee Umamusume toward achieving her goals.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Also, "Special Races" are held
at the end of each year during your training.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: The 'Grow Up Race' is held in the Junior Class, the 'WBC' in the Classic Class, and the 'SWBC' in the Senior Class—

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
And in the end, the "Grand Masters" will be held,
where you compete directly against the Three Goddesses.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: "Let's defeat those who govern vast amounts of data and aim for the pinnacle of Umamusume!"

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: "Even if you lose a race, you can still proceed as long as you've met the trainee Umamusume's objective, however—"

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
"Victories will lead to even greater growth for your Trainee,
so let's aim for an undefeated streak and head into
the Grand Masters in top form♪"

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
That concludes the explanation
regarding "Training Goals and Special Races."
Is there anything else you would like to know?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: About "Fragments of Knowledge," correct?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: By doing things like training or resting, you can obtain the wisdom of the Three Goddesses known as "Shards of Knowledge."

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: There are 3 types of Knowledge Fragments corresponding to the Three Goddesses, and they grant various effects such as increasing basic stats gained from training♪

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
The Goddess appearing for each action changes every turn,
but which Fragment you can obtain where will be displayed.
Take action alongside the Goddess holding the Fragment you want.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Also, it seems you can sometimes earn 2 Knowledge Fragments
at once from Friendship Training and the like.
If you get the chance, be sure to aim for it!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
The Knowledge Fragments you obtain are compiled
into the 'Knowledge Table,' a magnificent support
feature provided by the Three Goddesses.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
In addition to checking the effects of the Knowledge Fragments you've obtained,
connecting Fragments together will create a 'Crystal of Knowledge.'

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Please note that Shards of Knowledge will activate their effects
automatically every turn until you acquire the
"Goddess's Wisdom," explained separately.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
That concludes the explanation
regarding "Fragments of Knowledge."
Is there anything else you'd like to ask?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: About "Crystals of Knowledge," correct?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
When two Knowledge Fragments come together on the Knowledge Table,
a new insight—a "Crystal of Knowledge"—is born.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
A Crystal of Knowledge will inherit the effect
of one of the Knowledge Fragments used to create it.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Just like the Fragments of Knowledge, as long as it's organized in the Knowledge Chart, its effect activates automatically every turn!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Even after a Crystal of Knowledge is created,
the effects of the Knowledge Fragments used to make it will continue,
further boosting things like your training♪

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
That concludes the explanation
regarding "Crystals of Knowledge."
Is there anything else you'd like to ask?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: You wish to know about the ‘Goddesses' Wisdom’, correct?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Once the Knowledge Table is full of Knowledge Fragments,
the newly formed Crystals of Knowledge will also unite,
granting you a special insight: the "Goddess's Wisdom."

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
You can acquire Goddess's Wisdom whenever you like,
which will raise the corresponding
"Goddesses' Knowledge Lv."

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: As your Knowledge Level rises, the basic stats gained from training permanently increase♪

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
The stat boosts provided depend on the type of Goddess's Wisdom.
Generate the Wisdom that fits your training needs to raise your Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
"And there's one more important detail:
when you acquire a Goddess's Wisdom, a very powerful
special effect will activate for that turn only!"

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: The effect also varies depending on the type of Goddess's Wisdom, so deciding when to activate which effect is a crucial point♪

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
The type of Goddess's Wisdom is determined
by the color of the underlying Knowledge Crystal.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Additionally, Crystals of Knowledge tend to inherit the effect on the left side of their source Shards of Knowledge, so keep that trick in mind when gathering shards♪

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: By the way, once you acquire a Goddess's Wisdom, you'll receive a new Knowledge Table to gather Knowledge Fragments again, so let's keep acquiring them!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
“That concludes the explanation regarding the ‘Goddesses' Wisdom’.
Is there anything else you would like to ask?”

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Are you truly all right?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Understood♪ Just to be sure, I have a brief summary right here.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
You can review that explanation at any time
by tapping the 'i' button in the top left.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Well then, best of luck.
I'll be cheering you on quietly.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Understood. In that case, do your best,
okay? I'll be quietly cheering you on.
